---
title: "Installation"
---

Install SIGNAL from GitHub in R:

```{r, eval = FALSE}
if (!require("devtools", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("TingtHou/SIGNAL", build_vignettes = TRUE)
```

SIGNAL depends on `CompQuadForm`, `ggplot2`, `pbmcapply`, `RhpcBLASctl` and
packages that ship with R. Missing CRAN packages are installed automatically,
and nothing needs to be compiled.

```{r, eval = FALSE}
library(SIGNAL)
packageDescription("SIGNAL")$RemoteSha   # installed version (GitHub commit)
vignette("SIGNAL")                       # the Getting started example
```

**Windows:** SIGNAL runs genes in parallel by forking R processes (`ncores`).
Forking does not work on Windows, so there SIGNAL runs on one core. Use Linux
or macOS for parallel runs.
